elements.text:
The crystal shows two kinds of measure.

  /bAffinities/z are the sixteen elements. You gain one by casting that element. Some spells and scrolls need it, and it makes those spells cheaper: 5 percent off at level 5, 10 at 15, 20 at 30.

  /bSkills/z are everything else: the six schools of magic, and one skill for each craft. Casting raises /bSpell/z, rites raise /bRitual/z, brewing raises /bPotion/z.

  Ritual skill makes every rite cheaper by the same amounts, and it stacks with affinity.

  Potion skill stretches a brew: one extra draw at level 5, two at 15, three at 30. A flask turns those into extra charges instead.

  Your /bmagician level/z rises with all of it. It sets your mana, your spell charges, and what you may cast.
